mapper.select: SELECT r.ROLE_CD AS roleCd, r.ROLE_NM AS roleNm, r.ROLE_LEVEL AS roleLevel, r.DC AS dc, r.USE_YN AS useYn, DATE_FORMAT(r.REGIST_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS registDt, DATE_FORMAT(r.UPDT_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS updtDt, COUNT(er.EMP_NO) AS empCount FROM com_role r LEFT JOIN com_emp_role er ON r.ROLE_CD = er.ROLE_CD GROUP BY r.ROLE_CD, r.ROLE_NM, r.ROLE_LEVEL, r.DC, r.USE_YN, r.REGIST_DT, r.UPDT_DT ORDER BY r.ROLE_LEVEL ASC, r.ROLE_CD ASC

SELECT ROLE_CD AS roleCd, ROLE_NM AS roleNm, ROLE_LEVEL AS roleLevel, DC AS dc, USE_YN AS useYn, DATE_FORMAT(REGIST_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS registDt, DATE_FORMAT(UPDT_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS updtDt FROM com_role WHERE ROLE_CD = #{roleCd}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM com_role WHERE ROLE_CD = #{roleCd}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO com_role (ROLE_CD, ROLE_NM, ROLE_LEVEL, DC, USE_YN) VALUES (#{roleCd}, #{roleNm}, #{roleLevel}, #{dc}, IFNULL(#{useYn}, 'Y'))
mapper.update: UPDATE com_role SET USE_YN = #{useYn} WHERE ROLE_CD = #{roleCd}
mapper.select: SELECT e.EMP_NO AS empNo, e.EMP_NM AS empNm, e.DEPT_CD AS deptCd, d.DEPT_NM AS deptNm, p.JBGD_NM AS jbgdNm, e.EMP_STTS_CD AS empSttsCd, u.USER_ID AS userId, u.ACCT_LOCK_YN AS acctLockYn, u.USE_YN AS userUseYn, er.ROLE_CD AS roleCd, r.ROLE_NM AS roleNm, DATE_FORMAT(er.GRNT_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS grntDt, er.GRNT_EMP_NO AS grntEmpNo, er.EMP_ROLE_NO AS empRoleNo FROM com_emp_role er INNER JOIN hrm_emp_master e ON er.EMP_NO = e.EMP_NO INNER JOIN com_role r ON er.ROLE_CD = r.ROLE_CD LEFT JOIN hrm_dept_master d ON e.DEPT_CD = d.DEPT_CD LEFT JOIN hrm_pos_master p ON e.JBGD_CD = p.JBGD_CD LEFT JOIN com_user u ON e.EMP_NO = u.EMP_NO WHERE er.ROLE_CD = #{roleCd} ORDER BY e.DEPT_CD, e.EMP_NO

SELECT e.EMP_NO AS empNo, e.EMP_NM AS empNm, er.ROLE_CD AS roleCd, r.ROLE_NM AS roleNm, r.ROLE_LEVEL AS roleLevel, DATE_FORMAT(er.GRNT_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS grntDt, er.GRNT_EMP_NO AS grntEmpNo, er.EMP_ROLE_NO AS empRoleNo FROM com_emp_role er INNER JOIN hrm_emp_master e ON er.EMP_NO = e.EMP_NO INNER JOIN com_role r ON er.ROLE_CD = r.ROLE_CD WHERE er.EMP_NO = #{empNo} ORDER BY r.ROLE_LEVEL ASC

SELECT e.EMP_NO AS empNo, e.EMP_NM AS empNm, d.DEPT_NM AS deptNm, u.USER_ID AS userId, u.ACCT_LOCK_YN AS acctLockYn, u.USE_YN AS userUseYn FROM hrm_emp_master e INNER JOIN com_user u ON e.EMP_NO = u.EMP_NO LEFT JOIN hrm_dept_master d ON e.DEPT_CD = d.DEPT_CD WHERE e.EMP_STTS_CD != 'RESIGNED' ORDER BY e.DEPT_CD, e.EMP_NO
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO com_emp_role (EMP_NO, ROLE_CD, GRNT_EMP_NO) VALUES (#{empNo}, #{roleCd}, #{grntEmpNo})
